headline: Shinhan and SBI Pact to Explore Cross-Border Yen Stablecoin Payments
summary: Shinhan Bank and SBI Holdings will collaborate to explore card-linked merchant payments for Japanese visitors in South Korea using yen stablecoins.
why: Cross-border fintech partnerships between major Japanese and South Korean financial institutions aim to streamline regional payment remittances.

impacts.name: SBI Holdings
impacts.why: Integrating stablecoins into retail networks can improve cross-border transaction efficiency.
